headline:
Condos got
cheaper.
[[Houses didn't.]]
attribution: Roger Averbuj, Broker | Prestige Heritage Realty | (954) 663-8461
takeaway: Same county. Same month. Opposite directions.
sources: MIAMI REALTORS + RWorld, July 2026 Broward stats

stats.label: Broward condo median price fell to $255,000, the first real pullback in years.
Broward single-family median price climbed to $650,000 in the same month.
Condo inventory now sits at ten months of supply, more than double the 4.3 months for houses.
